name: Machine Leg Extension
grip: Hands gripping side support handles beside the seat.
description: Extend the knees against a padded roller while seated upright on a selectorized machine, isolating all four heads of the quadriceps through open-chain knee extension.
setup: Adjust the backrest so your knees align directly with the machine's pivot axis when seated.
Position the padded shin roller against the front of your lower shins just above the ankles.
Sit firmly with your lower back and glutes pressed against the backrest pad and grip the side stability handles.
instructions: Extend both knees smoothly forward and upward against the padded roller until legs are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at peak knee extension, squeezing your quadriceps forcefully.
Do not violently hyperextend or kick the weight up.
Lower the lever slowly under complete control back to the 90-degree starting knee flexion without allowing the weight stack to slam.
cues: Align knees with the machine pivot.
Extend legs smoothly and squeeze quads at the top.
commonMistakes: Kicking the weight explosively and hyperextending the knee joints.
Lifting hips and glutes off the seat to leverage heavier weight.
Setting the roller pad too high on the mid-shin or too low on the toes.

logging.note: Lever arm lengths and cam profiles vary across machine models; record selected stack pin load.

variantNote: Open-chain selectorized quadriceps isolation exercise. Unlike squats or leg presses, places peak tension on the rectus femoris and terminal knee extension.
